title: Notion Monthly Spend Buckets and Savings

messages.content: Check my connected Notion especially my Finances page then check my monthly spend break it down into monthly spend buckets and how much is saved monthly change nothing at all read only

Got it — one Notion workspace connected as "Personal." Found the 💸 Finances page. Let me pull up the full content now.Found two key databases inside the page: Expenses (under Monthly Allocation) and Breakdown (under Income & Budget). Let me pull both now.Got the full picture. Here's your financial breakdown from Notion: --- 💰 Finances — June 2026 (most recent complete month) Income: 24,960 SAR gross → 22,686.12 SAR net (after 2,274 GOSI) Monthly Spend Buckets 🐖 Savings (Reserve): 12,289.51 SAR — 54.2% This goes straight to the piggy bank 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: 4,500.00 SAR — 19.8% - Sana Allowance: 2,700 - Mom Allowance: 1,300 - Family Sadagah: 260 - Family Contribution: 240 🏠 Household: 4,331.61 SAR — 19.1% - Cash: 3,500 - Baity 5G: 405 - SEC Bill: 246.61 - Cars Cleaning: 180 🔧 Subscriptions & Tools: 1,565.00 SAR — 6.9% - Claude Max: 900 - DigitalOcean: 150 - Sawa Share Plus: 115 - Moontize: 100 - Wolffish: 100 - Netflix: 80 - Mom's Zoom: 80 - YouTube: 40 --- Bottom Line - Total spend: 10,396.61 SAR (excluding Reserve) - Monthly savings: 12,289.51 SAR (54.2% savings rate this month) - Cumulative saved: 128,000 SAR (42.9% average rate) - Safety buffer: 47,326 SAR (liquid cash on hand) You're saving over half your take-home, and your expense buckets are tight — the biggest non-savings line is family support at 4.5k, no debt payments anywhere. The financial creed is alive and well 🐟
